reuse.why: Extends getDateWithSkippedWeekend and adds an isWeekendOrHoliday predicate used inside shared/schedules.ts, but leaves it unexported, so server/schedules/app.ts writes the same weekend-or-holiday test inline twice.

duplication.why: The weekend-or-holiday check is repeated inline in getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange, duplicating the new isWeekendOrHoliday; the schedule-template copies are, on the other hand, folded into one local helper.

placement.why: The moving rule and predicate sit in shared/schedules.ts, but the daily-skip holiday decision for the server handlers lives in app.ts copies, and getAdjustedScheduleDate is a template-local wrapper around a shared helper.

scope.why: Focused on holidays; extracting getAdjustedScheduleDate in schedule-template is a small adjacent cleanup of the two copies it had to touch.

maintainability.why: Holiday moving is central, but the daily-skip rule now exists in three places (getNextDate via the predicate, two inline copies in app.ts), so the next change to what counts as a non-working day must touch all of them.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange test d.isWeekend || holidays.includes(...) inline instead of using the isWeekendOrHoliday predicate the diff adds in shared/schedules.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: The inline holiday checks in app.ts are visible copies of the predicate, not reshaped to hide it.

one_place.where: Holiday moving is defined once in getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but holiday skipping for daily schedules is decided separately in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate (isWeekendOrHoliday) and inline in server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange.
